name: FPI Net Equity Flows
description: Foreign portfolio investors' net buying or selling of Indian equities in a month, as reported by the depositories. Sustained outflows put pressure on the rupee and on index levels; inflows do the opposite.
source: NSDL FPI monitor via Finnovate, September 2026 report
releaseSchedule: Daily provisional data; monthly totals after month-end.
